method: read-only SSH of rig files and git diff; no UDP, reset, load, or JTAG command

scripts/bash/execute_program.sh.finding: The wrapper records PASS when the loader exits before its timeout, even if RUN_EXIT_STATUS is nonzero. Check the loader console, exit status, BootAddr readback, and workload result directly.

scripts/bash/read_bootrom.sh.finding: SCRIPT resolves to scripts/bash/udp_tsi_host.py, which does not exist; the actual loader is scripts/py/udp_tsi_host.py. This script probes BootROM at 0x10000, not BootAddrReg at 0x1000.

scripts/py/udp_tsi_host.py.finding: The FPGA reset-chip control path does not acknowledge chip reset; a printed success is not proof of the chip pin state.

capture_limits: Unprivileged strace observes only datagrams consumed by the loader. Rig login cannot use tcpdump without sudo and is outside the wireshark group required for dumpcap. A packet arriving after the loader stops receiving requires owner-enabled capture or a separately instrumented receive path.
